# x402 Unit Converter

Deterministic unit conversion microservice for agents.

POST /api/convert
Body: {"value": 100, "from": "km", "to": "mi"}
Price: ~$0.007 USDC on Base (x402)

Supports length, mass, temperature (C/F/K), volume, speed.
Free discovery: GET /catalog
No human in the loop. Stateless. Agent-native.
